title: USERELATIONSHIP cannot name two columns that have no relationship in the model
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], USERELATIONSHIP ( Sales[Quantity], Product[ProductKey] ) ) )

expected.error: Sales[Quantity] and Product[ProductKey] are not the end points of a relationship: USERELATIONSHIP returns an error

source.quote: An error is returned if any of the columns named as an argument is not part of a relationship or the arguments belong to different relationships
source.supports: the columns must be the two ends of an existing relationship

source.quote: You cannot use USERELATIONSHIP to create a relationship on the fly
